body_text:
If $T:V\to V$ has matrices $A$ and $A'$ in two ordered bases and
$P$ is the change-of-basis matrix, then $A'=P^{-1}AP$. Thus
matrices of the same operator are similar. Quantities invariant
under similarity, including determinant, trace, characteristic
polynomial, and eigenvalues with algebraic multiplicity, are
intrinsic to the operator.
